question: What pathways does the TP53 protein (UniProt P04637) participate in?
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein {uniprot_id: 'P04637'})-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway) RETURN pw.name ORDER BY pw.name LIMIT 10

question: Which proteins participate in the Apoptosis pathway?
What are the protein-protein interaction partners of TP53 (UniProt Q9UQ61)?
cypher: MATCH (p1:Protein {uniprot_id: 'Q9UQ61'})-[i:INTERACTS_WITH]-(p2:Protein) RETURN p2.uniprot_id ORDER BY p2.uniprot_id LIMIT 10

question: Do TP53 (P04637) and BRCA1 (P38398) share any pathways?
cypher: MATCH (a:Protein {uniprot_id: 'P04637'})-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway)<-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(b:Protein {uniprot_id: 'P38398'}) RETURN pw.name ORDER BY pw.name LIMIT 10

question: What pathways are connected to the Cell Cycle pathway through shared proteins?
cypher: MATCH (pw1:Pathway {name: 'Cell Cycle'})<-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw2:Pathway) WHERE pw2.name <> pw1.name RETURN pw2.name, count(p) AS shared ORDER BY shared DESC LIMIT 10

question: What GO terms are associated with proteins in the Apoptosis pathway?
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway {name: 'Apoptosis'}) MATCH (p)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(go:GOTerm) RETURN go.name, count(p) AS protein_count ORDER BY protein_count DESC LIMIT 10
